design_description: A bold red racing-inspired jersey built around sharp, angular tonal graphics. The base is bright red, with darker red lightning and slash shapes cutting diagonally across the body and becoming denser toward the lower section, so the shirt feels progressively faster from chest to hem. Because the graphics are worked red-on-red, they add movement and depth without breaking the shirt into separate colour blocks. The bottom incorporates a subtle racing checkerboard motif, blending naturally into the angular pattern rather than sitting on top of it as a separate band. Black collar and sleeve cuffs provide strong contrast against the red, while the cuffs add small black-and-white checkered detailing to reinforce the motorsport theme. The back continues the same red-on-red graphics, keeping the upper area open for identification, and is finished with a large white name and number outlined in dark red for clean legibility from distance. Overall it is clean, fast and aggressive, with clear racing influences carried through the slashes, the checkerboard and the trim detailing, without overloading the design or losing the strong single-colour identity.
